verdict.rationale: The site says to "Install the ones you want" and "Pick the skills and agents you use" with an installer that writes editable files. A real end-to-end probe confirmed `npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd` installed only the single tdd skill into .claude/skills/tdd/. The Claude, Codex and Copilot plugin routes install the whole set as one bundle, but the npx route clearly supports picking individual skills. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the per-skill selection flags (the `--skill` option is evidenced only by the probe), and no per-skill selection in the plugin-marketplace install routes.
